reviewer: Codex implementation-author subagent; not an independent human reviewer
review_scope: All 12 original D1 raw provider replies, result records, actual serialized requests and premise bindings, covering six distinct frozen unknown/conflict/prerequisite development cases. No model sends, reruns or holdout input/key content review. Original result status fields and journals stay unchanged.

scoring_interpretation.basis: Same frozen rubric and explicit useful-question interpretation recorded in author_review_D0.json; authored opinions, not independent validation.
scoring_interpretation.composite: Valid output AND correct authored label AND correct complete core mechanism without material error AND appropriate counterevidence AND a useful conditional human-verification question.
scoring_interpretation.questions: Repeating supplied values or already-available comparisons does not add conditional human verification. Borderline sample-sufficiency questions are documented rather than silently accepted as utility.
scoring_interpretation.mechanism_precision: A model may notice the decisive contrast but still fail the accepted mechanism flag by collapsing a declared conflict into mere missing information or adding a material unsupported role inference. contrast_detected is separately recorded. H43H tentative mismatch phrasing is imprecision, not a confirmed mismatch or high-impact fabrication.
scoring_interpretation.false_positive_denominators: Per frozen rubric, mismatch on authored alignment/not_applicable is a false positive. Mismatch on an unknown control is separately inappropriate certainty; known conflicts collapsed to underdetermined are separately loss of conflict distinction.
scoring_interpretation.permission_fabrication: N65M invents a REPORTED permitted operation, not authenticated real permission. It is materially wrong source-role semantics even though no action or actual permission grant occurs and canonical D source values stay correct.

summary.authored_mismatch_false_negative: NOT APPLICABLE; D1 has no authored mismatch cases. No zero false-negative reliability claim follows.
summary.scoped_counterevidence_intervention_evid: NOT RUN: all D1 requests have scope_mode=legacy. D1 cannot establish the effectiveness of the proposed H4 counterevidence_scope field; D3 remains unexecuted.
summary.qualification: Neither model-owned nor hybrid explanations meet authored composite usefulness. H improves several labels and preserves some distinctions, but still collapses a SOC conflict, returns mismatch on a read-only prerequisite despite its own not_applicable prose, and invents conflict in unknown-gate rationale. D remains a separate narrow declared-relationship result; no independent analyst usefulness or safety qualification follows.
